purpose: Evaluate educational behavior separately from unit tests. These cases are a review rubric, not proof of teaching effectiveness or tool authorization.
procedure: Use the actual composed StudyPi system prompt and preserve the recorded model, provider, parameters and tool availability.
Cases use no external tools unless the case explicitly supplies them; do not silently add retrieval, memory or an execution environment.
Run each case in a fresh conversation. Preserve every response. For multi-turn cases, send the next user turn after the model responds.
A human reviewer scores each criterion 0 (missing or contradicted), 1 (partial) or 2 (satisfied), and flags any critical failure.
Record tokens, latency, failures and missing usage data. Do not claim learning gains from this rubric alone.
